sipDefinition: A structured feedback loop for AI agents: record a failure, review the cause, test a correction and approve a versioned rule for reuse. It can reduce repeated errors, but each result still needs verification; it does not automatically retrain the model.
harnessModel: Seven layers, with verification across every layer. A practical model by Prateek Saxena, not a universal technical standard.
